title: Davenport Set Pattern #788
author: Spool Cotton Co., Spool Cotton #76 Home Decoration (via freevintagecrochet.com)
notes: Public domain vintage pattern. start: original "Ch 8, join with sl st." replaced by magic ring. Only the Head Rest block (rnds 1-13) kept; joining of blocks, picot edging and arm rests omitted. Shell corners (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc); odd rounds are sc in ch-5 loops, even rounds put 4-dc blocks in the centre loops (1, 3, 5, 3, 1 blocks per side) forming a diamond. pattern.dsl left EMPTY: R2 ends with the stated count '(4 shells made)', which the checker cannot parse, and rnds 10 and 12 do not say which loops get the blocks.
